Project Managers at Phase2 create a unique, engaging, and impactful client experience with long-term outcomes. They bring a future-focused perspective, anticipate client needs, and ensure decisions and direction align with what will drive meaningful progress and outcomes.

They bring clarity to ambiguity, guide clients through key decisions, and keep work moving forward, ensuring clients feel confident, supported, and satisfied.

This position reports to: VP, Project Management Compensation: Base annual salary of $120,000 - $155,000 What You’ll Do Own multi-workstream engagements end-to-end, ensuring delivery stays aligned with client goals, expected outcomes, and organizational standards.

Set direction by translating client objectives into structured plans, decision frameworks, and actionable priorities. Drive outcomes and client value with an emphasis on rapid time to value, using practical delivery discipline and AI-enabled approaches to accelerate insight, execution, and impact.

Lead the client relationship with confidence and clarity, ensuring expectations are understood, risks and mitigations are discussed early, and decisions continue moving forward. Direct cross-functional teams by establishing clear and outcome-aligned workflows, communication patterns, and accountability across all contributors.

Take ownership of engagement financials, including scope, forecasting, staffing, and margin performance, adjusting plans as conditions shift. Own and evolve the engagement roadmap and delivery approach ensuring work is sequenced to drive momentum, demonstrate value early, and unlock what’s next.

Embed AI tools into engagement workflows to strengthen planning, insight generation, communication, and decision support—setting expectations for how teams use AI to improve clarity, efficiency, and quality of work. Provide grounded recommendations that help clients evaluate tradeoffs, understand implications, and make informed decisions.

Identify risks early, lead mitigation efforts, and ensure issues are resolved with clarity and speed. Recognize and shape opportunities that arise naturally from delivery insight, client context, or emerging needs. Support the creation of proposals, estimates, and scopes that reflect realistic delivery plans and forward-looking client priorities.

Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, present recommendations, and guide decisions.

Deep understanding of digital platforms, product development lifecycles, and modern delivery practices. Demonstrated ability to embed AI in daily workflows and deliverables—using it to accelerate analysis, sharpen communication, synthesize information, and elevate the overall quality of engagement leadership.

Experience guiding teams in responsible, effective AI use, ensuring it enhances outcomes, improves speed and structure, and supports stronger decision-making. A track record of identifying meaningful opportunities rooted in client strategy, delivery insight, or future potential. Agency or consultancy experience preferred.

Teams operate with clarity, alignment, and consistent direction, even as priorities evolve. Engagements maintain predictable delivery, proactive risk management, and stable momentum.

Feedback Loop Efficiency: Speed and agility of adjusting project roadmaps based on incoming research and client data.
Process Leadership: Successful adoption of scalable project management frameworks across high-stakes, senior-led initiatives.

Avec une équipe dédiée d-experts FSI, nous fournissons des services de conseil en intégration et séparation, menons des missions complexes avec nos clients, et déployons une expertise fonctionnelle approfondie en finance, ressources humaines, commercial et technologie.
Chez Deloitte, nous accompagnons nos clients dans le conseil M&A de bout en bout, en travaillant étroitement avec nos collègues des services transactionnels, évaluations et finance d-entreprise. En tant que partie intégrante de la ligne d-affaires Stratégie, Risque et Transactions, nous collaborons également avec nos pairs en Stratégie, Durabilité, Réglementation, Criminalistique et Technologie pour assurer une approche fluide et axée sur la valeur des transactions.
**Comment vous ferez la différence **
* Leadership en intégration et séparation M&A : adopter une approche prospective et des méthodologies adaptées aux situations clients, pour diriger des séparations et intégrations M&A complexes.
* Création de valeur M&A : réaliser et superviser des analyses opérationnelles et financières pour évaluer les synergies, l-impact et les complexités des scissions, ainsi que le potentiel d-amélioration de la performance autonome des rachats et cessions d-entreprise.
* Service client exceptionnel : conseiller les clients à travers les offres de Deloitte, construire et maintenir des relations solides, tout en dirigeant les équipes de mission pour fournir un service client exceptionnel, en respectant la qualité et une méthodologie rigoureuse.
* Proximité avec la direction : développer votre capacité à mener des conversations avec les CXO clients, en traduisant les idées en solutions concrètes, et devenir le contact privilégié du client pour la transformation de la livraison.
* Portée et exécution du projet : définir, planifier, allouer les ressources et exécuter la portée du projet ; gérer les attentes et les délais avec les clients, en assurant des livrables de haute qualité.
* Leadership et développement d-équipe : inspirer et guider les membres de l-équipe pour atteindre leur plein potentiel, en favorisant un environnement collaboratif qui encourage l-innovation et l-excellence dans l-exécution des projets.
* Solutions analytiques et IA : fournir des insights stratégiques, des conseils et déployer des solutions analytiques avancées et d-intelligence artificielle.
**Profil recherché **
* Expérience démontrée dans le secteur FSI, esprit entrepreneurial, attitude d-auto-démarrage, grande motivation pour diriger et se développer, avec capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement dynamique et rapide avec des délais serrés et des priorités évolutives.
* Solides capacités de résolution de problèmes avec un focus sur la prise de décision stratégique et l-attention aux détails, ainsi qu-une capacité avérée à simplifier des concepts complexes, créer des récits au niveau exécutif et synthétiser efficacement la valeur.
* Diplôme de licence ou master d-universités de premier plan avec des résultats académiques exceptionnels.
* Minimum de 7 ans d-expérience pertinente en M&A dans des rôles de conseil ou en industrie, avec une expérience claire dans l-un de nos principaux secteurs, à savoir banque, gestion de patrimoine et assurance.
* Solide sens de la gestion de projet et des parties prenantes, avec des compétences de haute qualité en Excel, PowerPoint et storytelling exécutif.
* Aptitude aux technologies d-IA et intérêt marqué pour intégrer des solutions d-IA dans nos offres afin d-améliorer les résultats clients et stimuler l-innovation.
* Maîtrise de l-anglais, excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et expérience de travail au sein d-une communauté internationale. La maîtrise de l-allemand est souhaitée.

Hi, we're Amy Ogren and Robert Hulbert, and we're looking for a Delivery Manager to join our growing Biomechanics Value Stream. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing areas within Sony Sports Technology. Our team combines Hawk-Eye's world-leading tracking technology with KinaTrax's markerless motion capture systems to provide cutting-edge athlete performance insights across elite sport.
You'll be joining a collaborative team of around 20 people that's expected to grow to approximately 25 over the coming year. Unlike many delivery roles that focus on a single product or sport, you'll support initiatives across Major League Baseball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, cricket, tennis and golf.
You'll also be joining at an exciting time as we continue delivering one of Sony Sports Technology's largest strategic partnerships while helping shape the future of biomechanics technology.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems and helping technical teams deliver their best work.
As a Delivery Manager, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Solution Owners and software engineers to coordinate the delivery of technical initiatives across our biomechanics products.
You'll help keep projects moving by managing priorities, coordinating dependencies, identifying risks early and ensuring teams have the information they need to deliver successfully.
This isn't a traditional project management role. Priorities can change quickly as new opportunities emerge across multiple sports, so we're looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where no two weeks are quite the same.
What You'll Work On
Supporting delivery across multiple biomechanics products and sports initiatives.
Coordinating work across engineering, product and operational teams.
Managing delivery roadmaps, milestones and project planning activities.
Supporting Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and delivery processes.
Tracking project progress and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery.
Identifying risks, dependencies and blockers before they impact delivery.
Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads and Solution Owners to coordinate priorities.
Helping improve delivery processes and ways of working across the Biomechanics Value Stream.
Building strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders across Sony Sports Technology.
What Success Looks Like
Your first few months will focus on learning the products, understanding how our teams work and building strong relationships across the business.
As your confidence grows, you'll begin taking ownership of delivery activities, supporting roadmap planning, identifying delivery risks and helping improve the way the team collaborates.
Success in this role isn't about changing everything on day one. It's about learning quickly, building trust and becoming someone the team relies on to help deliver complex technical projects successfully.

Coordinate the successful delivery of initiatives across the Biomechanics Value Stream.
Maintain delivery roadmaps, milestones and project timelines across multiple workstreams.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and backlog refinement.
Track project dependencies, risks and blockers, ensuring they are managed proactively.
Support Product Managers and Engineering Leads with delivery planning and prioritisation.
Monitor delivery health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
Escalate delivery risks with clear recommendations and proposed mitigation plans.
Help improve Agile delivery practices, team collaboration and operational efficiency.
Support cross-functional communication between engineering, product, operations and business teams.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency and accountability.
Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Experience supporting software, technical or product delivery within a technology environment.
An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
Experience using Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration and planning tools.
Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working alongside engineering or technical teams.
A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
A genuine interest in technology and delivering high-quality products.

Exposure to sports technology or biomechanics.
Experience working across multiple technical teams.
An understanding of software development lifecycles.
A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Sports Science, Biomechanics, Project Management or a related discipline is preferred, but not essential.
